all.source_quote: The applicant must be a woman
must belong to a poor household based on submission of a deprivation declaration

unmodelled.text: No other LPG connection from any OMC in the same household
unmodelled.source_quote: There should be no other LPG connection from any Oil Marketing Company (OMC) within the same household.

unmodelled.text: Must have a valid Aadhaar number
unmodelled.source_quote: Applicant must have a valid Aadhaar number (for identificationand subsidy transfer).

unmodelled.text: Must have a bank account to receive subsidy through DBT
unmodelled.source_quote: Must have abank account to receive subsidy through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
